result: Persisted swing/position/momentum book rows now adapt into normalized BOOK_POSITION events consumed by ForwardSessionRunner. The adapter is read-only and daily-session based; a 20-session position remains active across overnight sessions, an unfilled signal stays ENTRY_PENDING, and an open position at its horizon remains EXIT_DUE for close reconciliation.
focused_tests: 86 passed (forward-session crash, runner, clock, Kite, intraday, session-date, and book integration)
limitations: This is a local paper-book state bridge; it makes no claim about market-data rights, observed fills, or live-account integration.
